blockers.claim: The tracked lead config sets model = 'gpt-5.6-terra' (line 12) and fallback_subagent_model = 'gpt-5.6-luna' (line 14), but CLAUDE.md's Codex lead routing paragraph and the brief say the lead is Astra/high with Terra/high as the fallback; reproduce by comparing grep -n model .codex/config.toml with that paragraph.

The packet adds the rule 'The Codex control set is checked at the top level' to AGENTS.md and the CHANGELOG and INTERNALS entries say it lives in CLAUDE.md, but the diff has no CLAUDE.md hunk, so sha256(CLAUDE.md) != sha256(AGENTS.md) and the hard invariant breaks; reproduce with sha256sum CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md after applying the patch.

The 2026-10-27 entry states the playbook mirrors (new-project.md, retrofit.md) were not part of this pass, yet CLAUDE.md requires every template change to be mirrored in its playbook and check in the same commit, and the diff touches no playbook file.

advisories.claim: _TOP_LEVEL_SCALAR only matches double-quoted basic strings with no trailing comment, so a valid role file with name = 'builder' (literal string), name = "builder"  # comment, or single-line name = """builder""" is reported as a missing top-level name; reproduce by writing one such role file and running check.
_top_level_strings is a copy of the production reader, so the template-value tests (lines 525-541) exercise the copy and not _top_level_toml_strings; only the gap tests run the real reader.
test_this_repo_passes_the_codex_audit (line 705) checks only the presence of the config and the four OK lines, not the config's model values, so a wrong lead model in the dogfood file goes unnoticed.
CONTROL_FILES drops docs/README.md (around line 749 of the diff) to keep retrofit at 25 checks; confirm the 'docs classified' finding still reports a missing docs/README.md, or retrofit loses a gap.
The lead results show only pytest and ruff; no run of python tools/jumpstart.py check . or retrofit . on this repo is reported, though the CHANGELOG claims 12 checks and no gaps.
The file-scoped ask-first rule covers templates/.codex/agents/*.toml; the owner's brief names these edits, so the brief should be recorded as the ask before merge.

tests: Covers install-without-overwrite, the check and retrofit gaps for missing config, missing role file and missing metadata, and top-level-only reading with a multi-line body; misses the dogfood config's values, a real check run in the lead results, and literal-string or commented role files.
